What’s the difference between Email Live Sending and Email Sandbox products?

The main difference is that Email Live Sending is built for developers and DevOps teams to deliver production emails directly to customer inboxes. Email Sandbox provides dev and QA teams a safe environment to inspect and debug emails in development or staging, capturing outgoing messages so they never reach real customers.
What’s the difference between Email Live Sending and Email Marketing products?

Email Live Sending allows you to send both transactional and bulk emails via SMTP or API integrations. Email Marketing is designed to build, schedule, and manage campaigns directly through the Mailtrap interface and contact list manager.
What happens if I hit the limits of my Email Live Sending plan?
On paid plans, sending doesn’t stop. Emails over your monthly limit are billed as extra emails, at your plan’s cost per 1,000 (see “Extra emails” in the comparison table).

On the Free plan, sending stops at the monthly limit and you’ll receive the SMTP error “535 5.7.0 Monthly messages limit reached”. To keep sending, upgrade to a paid plan or wait until the limit resets at the start of the next billing period.
Do you provide help with setting up Mailtrap for sending?
Yes, Mailtrap provides setup instructions for a range of domain providers and a getting started guide
to assist you with the Email Live Sending or the Email Marketing setup process. Mailtrap’s deliverability team
is also available for setup assistance, and the support team can answer all related questions.
Do you help with migration from another sending provider?

Yes, Mailtrap’s deliverability and tech experts provide dedicated migration support for senders with volumes exceeding 200K, with a strategy tailored to their business needs. For smaller-scale senders, we offer free migration guides
Do I need to buy Email Live Sending, Email Marketing and Email Sandbox separately?
Yes, Email Live Sending, Email Marketing and Email Sandbox are sold separately, all offering a free plan and multiple paid options.
Does Email Live Sending have a free plan?
Yes. The Email Live Sending free plan includes 4,000 emails per month for free, no credit card required.
